**The Fixer** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

The Fixer shares most of its available modifications with the Combat Rifle. The Fixer has a hidden, non-removable mod which provides several additional bonuses:

The Fixer will always spawns with the following combat rifle modifications pre-applied:
